consequence.statement: ClusterSecretStore objects using the external-secrets.io/v1beta1 schema whose spec.provider.fake.data[] entries omit value are rejected, because value is now in the required list of each fake data item.
consequence.remediation: Set spec.provider.fake.data[].value in every data entry of fake-provider ClusterSecretStore objects (it is now required alongside key).

original.statement: ClusterSecretStore v1beta1 schema: 1 field now required: `spec.provider.fake.data[].value`

decision.reason: [ev-9fd85560a485] shows that from 0.15.0 to 0.16.0, the v1beta1 ClusterSecretStore schema changed spec.provider.fake.data.items.required from ["key"] to ["key","value"]. Under the new CRD schema, the API server's validation rejects objects whose fake data entries leave out value, so resource-rejected is the right kind and medium severity fits. The SecretStore change in [ev-210dbd3942ad] is the same change in a separate CRD, so it does not affect this fact.
